name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.5.

A proper wait screen while updating: ASVA now shows a full "Updating, I will reopen by myself in a minute, your data is safe" screen for the whole update, not just a flash, so it never feels like the app vanished.

Clearer Escalate: sending a firm formal reminder to one customer is now easy to read and to confirm. You see the exact letter and a clear Send button, and ASVA sends it only when you decide.

Call on desktop that works: on the computer you now get the customer's number to dial and a WhatsApp button to message or call them, instead of a Call button that did nothing on a PC.

Credit health, quietly: open any customer and, only when it matters, ASVA shows a calm note about how exposed you are before you extend more credit. No pop-ups, no flags on every bill.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
